title: كُوب – Kub Coffee | Specialty coffee in Daraa
description: Kub is a cosy café in Daraa: hanging plants, warm wood and specialty coffee. See the menu and opening hours, and find your way to us.

hero.imageAlt: Kub's glass entrance with the illuminated logo sign and wooden seating inside

menu.heading: The menu
menu.intro: Straight from the boards above the bar. Prices in Syrian pounds.

values.heading: Natural and cosy
values.body: Hanging plants, oak, soft olive benches and baristas drawn on the wall. Come for a coffee and take your time.

gallery.heading: Inside Kub
gallery.note: These are 3D concept renders of the space. Real photos are coming soon.
